title: Pinned box
description: The contents of box.yml: the sandbox (lbx) release, its commit, the sha256 of its launcher binary and the agent image digest every job runs with. The Publish image workflow prints them; flax agents box-release pin writes them.

pinned.description: false while the values are placeholders; jobs refuse to run until it is true.

box_release.description: The sandbox (lbx) release tag vX.Y.Z whose launcher binary every run uses. v0.0.0 is the placeholder.

box_commit.description: Full commit id the release names (its notes block); recorded for the record, since the binary is what runs. Its lbx must have --socket-dir and --no-network.

image.description: The image jobs run in, by digest: the agent image built from images/agent/Dockerfile (flax.yml agents.agentImage).

lbx_sha256.description: The sha256 of the release's lbx-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl asset, from its .sha256 file; the action refuses to run a binary that does not match. All zeros is the placeholder.
